qualification: A routed row needs exact FF inventory, parallel ATPG loading and scan-out verification, unchanged functional structure and placement, same-stage physical and timing records, and zero detailed-route DRC.
C1: All planned architectures deterministic; source/placed FF bijection and every pattern's K-chain loading and scan-out verified; input and tool hashes complete

C2.scope: all planned design x physical_seed x K x method runs; complete pairs contain every predeclared method for that design x seed x K

C3.rule: same design-seed-K qualified physical optimum versus activity optimum; both practical thresholds must hold

C6.rule: no single simple method and no small fixed deterministic-method portfolio may 2-percent cover every discovered primary Pareto point in 80 percent or more of complete design-seed-K cases

C7.metric: port-aware scan HPWL proxy delta around a physically qualified parent; child has independent structural and ATPG-load verification but is not presumed routed
C7.rule: at least one legal intervention class has both positive and negative port-aware physical-proxy deltas, each at least 20 percent of at least 20 matched cases, in 4 seeds on 2 designs

C8.count_model: N! * binomial(N-1,K-1) labelled nonempty ordered chains

C9: PASS only when C1-C8 all PASS on a frozen completed campaign; otherwise top-level FAIL

threshold_justification.C2: A 90% row floor permits at most 37 isolated physical failures while the 80% complete-pair floor preserves at least 48 fully paired design-seed-K comparisons; all three designs remain mandatory.
threshold_justification.C3: The 5% H_eff and 10% port-aware HPWL thresholds retain the prospective engineering relevance levels proposed before the final campaign and exclude the small numerical separations that failed to replicate in Phase-0B.
threshold_justification.C4_C5: Four of five conditional placement seeds is a conservative within-design supermajority; requiring two designs prevents one netlist from establishing generality.
threshold_justification.C6: A 2% two-objective tolerance treats near-equivalent deterministic outcomes as covered, while the strict below-80% rule requires measurable failure across more than one fifth of complete contexts.
threshold_justification.C7: Twenty fixed proposals provide a minimum count of four positive and four negative effects at the 20% sign threshold; four seeds on two designs mirrors the conflict-replication standard.
threshold_justification.C8: A log10 space size of 100 is already far beyond enumeration and is conservative for the qualified FF inventories.

incomplete_policy: Unassessable gates are NOT QUALIFIED; top-level classification is FAIL, never GO
